answer: Require every identity to lock 250 POA for 21 days before it can earn, plus a 7-day withdrawal queue. One account is cheap, but each added sockpuppet needs its own separate 250 POA lock, so 100 fakes tie up 25,000 POA for a month with no reuse. Like plots in a garden, bonds are dye-traced: a pigment tag follows each lock's funding path on the ledger, and recycling one bond across accounts triggers a 30% slash. A comet burst of signups thus raises capital cost linearly per identity. Attesters verify lock age and balance before countersigning, and rewards vest only after 10 attested epochs.
